Meta.Purpose: Generate a comprehensive, research-level chapter and section hierarchy for a mathematics subject
Meta.Audience: Advanced students, practitioners, and researchers working in AI/ML/LLMs
Meta.Depth: Graduate-level textbook with practical AI/ML applications

Level1.name: Chapter
Level1.Instruction: List all major chapters. Each chapter is a self-contained conceptual unit.
Level1.Fields: title, motivation, ai_ml_relevance, prerequisite_chapters, key_theorems[], key_papers[]

Level2.name: Section
Level2.Instruction: For each chapter, list all sections. Each section covers one mathematical concept or technique.
Level2.Fields: title, intuition, formal_definition, key_results[], visualizations[], difficulty

Level3.name: SubSection
Level3.Instruction: For each section, list sub-sections covering proofs, examples, and applications.

OutputFormat.Schema: JSON with nested chapters → sections → subsections
